role: fdlibm's sin, cos, pow and atan2 (with its rem_pio2 argument reduction), ported unchanged so java.lang.Math.sin/cos and StrictMath.pow/atan2 results match bit for bit.
notes: Ports the JDK's StrictMath (fdlibm), not a oracle/src file. Only static const tables; no mutable state, allocation or recursion. Callers include ai.c, living.c, projectile.c, dragon.c and several hostiles files, so it runs in the tick; the tests listed are tick tests that go through those callers, not direct unit tests of smath.
